comingNext.searchText: A search engine for the own data of your organization. No model involved: the same words give the same results, filtered by collection, source, type and date.
comingNext.collectionsText: Every collection with its documents, their source and their last update, and a way to open any of them.
comingNext.sourcesText: Connect Drive, SharePoint, Confluence and more, see how each synchronization is going, and learn why a document is missing.
comingNext.settingsTitle: Choose the models and the access
comingNext.settingsText: The embedding and reranking models of the organization, and who can read which collection.
